messages:
jess_support: heads-up — acme reported sustained 429s and token-level latency on their Dedicated pool starting ~09:58 UTC. They say it correlates with a long-context job that pads to ~28k tokens. can we triage?
ryan_customer: here are sample request IDs: req_1a2b3c, req_1a2b3d. we see 200->slow->429 in sequence, nothing obvious from our side. pool is dedicated-redwood-3.
chris_sre: on it. please capture a short repro curl if possible. meanwhile pulling infra logs for that pool.
jess_support: repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -H "X-Tenant: acme" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"<30k tokens>"}' -i
```
Expect: returns 200 then streaming. Observed: initial chunk then pause then 429.
autoscale-bot: Autoscaler event: pool=dedicated-redwood-3 scale_up_attempt=1 reason=kv_pressure backoff=30s
chris_sre: looking at node-level logs — seeing repeated eviction spikes and small free-run allocations. sample lines:
```
[2024-03-02T09:58:12Z] KV_EVICT tenant=acme freed=3.2MB entries=14 reason=mem_pressure
[2024-03-02T09:58:12Z] ALLOC_FAIL size=262144 backtrace=... shard=12
[2024-03-02T09:58:13Z] KV_COMPACT coalesce_window=512 -> fragmented=7
```
chris_sre: pattern looks like fragmentation + lots of tiny evicts from prefix cache for long-context sessions. eviction churn is causing per-token latency and then throttles when allocator can't satisfy bursts.
jess_support: any quick mitigations? customer is hitting user-facing errors.
maria_eng-runtime: immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) flip tenant flag to disable prefix coalescing ("kv.coalesce_window") for acme to reduce churn; 2) bump reserved_kv_mem for acme by +256MB; 3) temporarily raise autoscale headroom to +2 nodes for that pool. I'll run 1 and 2 if SRE approves.
chris_sre: +1, doing 1) and 3) makes sense. also recommend a rolling restart of the busiest node after the eviction churn subsides to defragment memory.
chris_sre: commands I'll run (internal):
```
kvctl set-tenant acme kv.coalesce_window=0 --cluster dedicated-redwood-3
kvctl set-tenant acme reserved_kv_mem=512MB --cluster dedicated-redwood-3
autoscalectl force-scale --pool dedicated-redwood-3 --delta +2 --reason "kv pressure mitigation"
```
jess_support: sent to customer: "we're applying mitigations now (reducing coalescing, adding reserved memory, extra nodes). we'll follow up in ~10m with status." :thumbsup:
ryan_customer: thanks — appreciate the quick action. we can throttle our long-context jobs if you need more time.
chris_sre: FYI for eng-runtime follow-up: we observed heavy churn due to many small KV slice allocations caused by tokenized segments for long-context sessions. propose a longer-term fix: 1) increase coalesce threshold heuristics to reduce small-entry churn, 2) implement slab allocator improvements to avoid cross-shard fragmentation, 3) add a soft-qos to reject single-request bursts above X tokens rather than evicting.
maria_eng-runtime: adding a short repro we used locally: send 6 parallel requests with payloads of ~25k tokens and a 1s inter-arrival — reproduces the eviction spike in ~60s. curl script:
```
for i in {1..6}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -H "X-Tenant: acme" \
    -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"<25k tokens>"}' &
done; wait
```
chris_sre: after applying kv.coalesce_window=0 and reserved bump, eviction rate dropped ~80% on monitored nodes in the pool, autoscale added 2 nodes. observed 429s subsided. continuing to watch.
lena_product: do we need to notify accounts/payments? looks like this was a technical issue, not billing.
jess_support: no billing impact. customer-facing postmortem note will be prepared if they ask. closing loop once we validate stability for 24h.
ryan_customer: confirmed traffic looks normal again, thanks. will keep you posted if anything else shows up.
maria_eng-runtime: follow-ups for sprint: ticket INF-4923 to tune coalesce heuristics, INF-4924 to prototype slab allocator adjustments, INF-4925 to add token-burst soft-qos.
jess_support: thanks all — marking initial support thread resolved pending 24h watch. :white_check_mark:
